Job Summary 
We are seeking a detail-oriented Senior Data Analyst to join our Data Breach Response team. You will be responsible for analysing complex, often unstructured datasets resulting from cyber security incidents. Your primary goal is to identify impacted individuals, extract sensitive information (PII/PHI), and ensure data integrity for regulatory notification purposes.

Key Responsibilities 
Data Mining & Extraction: Perform manual and automated extraction of sensitive data from compromised file systems, emails, and databases.
Data Normalization & Cleanup: Clean, de-duplicate, and format massive sets of messy data to create a "Single Version of Truth" for legal review.
Quality Assurance: Conduct rigorous QA checks on datasets to ensure 100% accuracy before notification lists are generated.
Reporting: Translate complex data findings into actionable reports for legal counsel and stakeholders.
Process Optimization: Develop and maintain workflows (using Excel/SQL) to speed up the identification of PII/PHI.

Required Technical Skills 
Advanced Excel: Mastery of Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Index/Match, Power Query, and complex nested formulas.
SQL: Ability to write complex queries to extract, filter, and join data from relational databases.
Data Handling: Proven experience in Manual Extraction and Data Cleanups from unstructured sources (e.g., OCR outputs).
Field Expertise: Minimum of 3 years specifically within the Data Breach sector. 

Preferred Skills (The "Plus" List) 
VBA/Macros: Ability to automate repetitive Excel tasks to improve turnaround time.
Python: Experience using Pandas/NumPy for large-scale data manipulation and cleaning.
RegEx: Knowledge of Regular Expressions for pattern matching (e.g., finding SSNs or Credit Card numbers).

Data Engineer 
What s important to us: 
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Data Engineer with over 4 years of professional experience in building, automating, and optimizing data pipelines and cloud-based architectures. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with cloud data services (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and CI/CD pipelines for deploying scalable, reliable, and secure data solutions. 
The candidate will collaborate with cross-functional teams including data analysts, data scientists, and software engineers to design and maintain robust data infrastructure that supports analytics, AI/ML workflows, and enterprise reporting systems. 
Key Responsibilities: 
Design, build, and maintain end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines using both on-premise and cloud-based technologies. 
Architect and operate data storage and streaming solutions leveraging cloud-based services on AWS , Azure , or GCP . 
Design and implement data ingestion and transformation workflows using Airflow , AWS Glue , or Azure Data Factory . 
Develop and optimize data pipelines using Python and PySpark for large-scale distributed data processing. 
Build data models - normalized, denormalized, and dimensional ( Star/Snowflake ) - for analytics and warehousing solutions. 
Implement data quality , lineage , and governance using metadata management and monitoring tools. 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver clean, reliable, and timely data for analytics and machine learning use cases. 
Integrate CI/CD pipelines for data infrastructure deployment using GitHub Actions , Jenkins , or Azure DevOps . 
Automate infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as AWS CloudFormation or Terraform . 
Monitor and optimize data processing performance for scalability, reliability
